title: Canonical ordinary zero-section arrows
statement: Fix a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$ and a scheme $T$. Use affine and projective geometry [def-sbc-affine-space], [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], the unique normalized supported ordinary Kummer class [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer], and the line maps [def-pur-coordinate-line-adjunction-maps]. Define the literal zero section, ordinary closed direct image and affine-chart compact-support functor with their existing adjunctions. Define the canonical comparison $Rp_!s_*\simeq\mathrm{id}$ by compactification, the compact-support compositor [def-sf-etale-support-compositor], the congruence along $ps=\mathrm{id}$ [def-pur-compact-support-morphism-congruence] and the identity comparison of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons], and its exceptional conjugate $Rs^!Rp^!\simeq\mathrm{id}$ by [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. For every positive invertible $N$ killing $A$ and Cartier zero section, define the ordinary supported Cartier class by the existing unique boundary-normalized class, its derived morphism, and its expression in the chart-restricted shifted projective Tate line via the normalized twist pullback [def-amb-p1-trace].
